scope: APPLICATION-LEVEL encryption-at-rest primitive (app/core/encryption.py), AES-256-GCM via the cryptography library. Key supplied via ENCRYPTION_KEY_B64 env var, never hardcoded, never committed.
boundary_disclosure: This module is implemented and fully tested in isolation. It is NOT yet wired into the document-upload pipeline, FAISS index/metadata files, or PostgreSQL columns -- doing so requires a migration story for already-uploaded plaintext data and is a larger, separate change not made in this pass. PLATFORM-level encryption (e.g. an encrypted EBS volume on a live EC2 deployment) is a distinct, separate concern -- see docs/CHECKLIST.md Encryption row -- and remains unconfigured since no live deployment exists.

cases: ciphertext differs from plaintext and varies by nonce across calls
missing key raises an explicit error, never silently stores plaintext
malformed/wrong-length key raises an explicit error
associated_data binds ciphertext to context (prevents cross-record ciphertext swap)

current_status: PARTIAL (Implemented and tested; not yet integrated into the production upload/storage pipeline)
